description: Extract key lease terms (tenant, base rent, area, parking, small-repair cap) from the markdown lease agreement — no structured pool path exists for these, so constants must be produced.

tool.name: recordLeaseTerms
tool.description: Record key commercial-lease terms into the property management system.

tenantName.description: Legal name of the tenant entity (company / GmbH), without representatives or addresses.

baseMonthlyRentEUR.description: Base monthly rent in EUR (numeric, no currency symbol or thousands separator).

areaSquareMeters.description: Total rentable area of the premises in square metres.

parkingLotCount.description: Number of dedicated parking spaces included in the lease.

smallRepairLimitEUR.description: Per-case EUR cap the tenant bears for small repairs (Kleinreparaturen).
